title: Orthographic depth at two scales, with English also matched for lexicon size
abstract: arXiv:2611.13400v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A reader can struggle to read in only one of their languages, and one proposed reason is how predictably spelling maps to sound. We measure that predictability as conditional entropy, the pronunciation uncertainty left once the spelling is seen, at two grain sizes (unit sizes): the alignment unit, an aligned spelling-sound chunk, and the syllable, bounded in the pronunciation. We analyse word lists in twelve alphabetic orthographies and report five in full, with English pronunciations from a dictionary and the rest from the synthesizer eSpeak-ng, length marks removed. Among the five, English has the most uncertainty and Finnish the least at both grains. Across all twelve, Portuguese and Danish exceed English per alignment unit, and German and Italian order differently by grain and transcription. These orders hold when English is transcribed by eSpeak-ng with u allowed to spell /j/ plus a vowel. Uncertainty per unit has no shared direct

translated_title: 两个尺度上的正字法深度：英语还进行了词汇量匹配
translated_abstract: 一个读者可能只在自己的某一种语言中遇到阅读困难，一个被提出的解释是拼写映射到语音的可预测程度。我们用条件熵来度量这种可预测性，即看到拼写后残留的发音不确定性，并在两个粒度（单元大小）上进行测量：对齐单元（对齐的拼写-语音片段）和音节（发音上有边界的单位）。我们分析了十二种字母文字系统的词表，并完整报告其中五种，其中英语的发音来自词典，其余来自合成器 eSpeak-ng（已去除长度标记）。在这五种中，英语在两个粒度上都具有最大的不确定性，而芬兰语最小。在全部十二种中，按对齐单元计算时葡萄牙语和丹麦语超过英语，而德语和意大利语的排序则因粒度和转写方式的不同而不同。当英语改用 eSpeak-ng 转写（允许 u 拼写 /j/ 加元音）时，这些排序仍然成立。单位不确定性没有共享的直接……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出在两个粒度（对齐单元与音节）上用条件熵度量正字法深度，对十二种字母文字的分析发现英语不确定性最大、芬兰语最小，且排序结果对英语不同转写方式保持稳健。
en_tdlr: This paper measures orthographic depth as conditional entropy at two grain sizes (alignment unit and syllable) across twelve alphabetic orthographies, finding English the most uncertain and Finnish the least, with the rankings robust to alternative English transcriptions.
